page.layout: One column of running text, printed page 32 at the top left, running head at the top centre-left. Left and right margins contain only rules and marks, no printed text. Catchword at the foot right.

main_text.p: [illegible, ~8 letters] quæ proveniebant ex publicis civitatis possessionibus, ut fodinis metallicis, nemoribus, agris publicis: item portoria, quæ ex mercibus importatis & exportatis solvebantur in portubus, quinquagesimæ scilicet mercium, interdum etiam decimæ: tum & [illegible, ~8 letters] tributum, quod quotannis penfitabant inquilini urbis Atticæ, drachmas nempe xii in virorum, vi in fœminarum capita, & quod servi folvebant à dominis manumissi. Φόροι dicebantur tributa annua sociis civitatibus indicta post Xerxem è Græciâ submotum, ad Persarum arma, si qua motu deinceps essent, reprimenda, directore Aristide, modica primùm, sed post plurimum aucta, ut ad mille talenta Attica ascenderent: quorum ταμεῖον[?] initio in insulâ Delo ex voluntate sociorum constitutum, deinde bellis commotis Athenas est translatum. Εἰσφοραί nuncupabantur tributa extra ordinem poscente belli necessitate decreto senatus & concionis pro facultatum modo civibus inquilinisque imperata. Demum τιμήματα[?] erant multæ damnatorum in judiciis, quorum nomina statim inscribebantur tabulis publicis in arce repositis cum multæ summa

page.notes: Printed "motu" in "si qua motu" is read as "mouri" in the scan; "motu" is the best reading and is not fully certain. The first Greek word on the first line and the Greek word after "&" (in the line "tum &") are not legible enough to read letter by letter. The word "ταμεῖον" and "τιμήματα" are doubtful. The page number "32" at the top left is partly obscured and marked [?]. The catchword "sum-" at the foot right is partly unclear and marked [?].
